================ FILE: C:\Users\trcnologia\Desktop\LegoLoop\internal\studio\processos_api.go ================

package studio

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"legoloop/internal/compor"
	"legoloop/internal/listar"
	"legoloop/internal/processo"
	"legoloop/internal/refinar"
	"legoloop/internal/remover"
)

func (s *Server) processoStore() (processo.Store, error) {
	if s.StoreOverride != nil {
		return *s.StoreOverride, nil
	}
	v, err := s.vault()
	if err != nil {
		return processo.Store{}, err
	}
	docs := s.ProjectDir
	if docs == "" {
		docs = "."
	}
	return processo.Store{Roots: processo.Roots{Vault: v, Docs: docs}}, nil
}

func (s *Server) handleProcessosListar(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		writeError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "método não permitido")
		return
	}
	st, err := s.processoStore()
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}
	res, err := listar.Run(r.Context(), listar.Deps{Store: st, Home: s.Home})
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, listar.ErrSemCofre) {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(res)
}

type procRefinarReq struct {
	Name   string   `json:"name"`
	Etapa  string   `json:"etapa"`
	Peca   string   `json:"peca"`
	Caso   []string `json:"caso"`
	Titulo string   `json:"titulo"`
	Apply  bool     `json:"apply"`
}

func (s *Server) handleProcessosRefinar(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "método não permitido")
		return
	}
	var req procRefinarReq
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "corpo inválido")
		return
	}
	st, err := s.processoStore()
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}
	refReq := refinar.Request{
		Nome:    req.Name,
		Mudanca: refinar.Mudanca{Etapa: req.Etapa, Peca: req.Peca, Titulo: req.Titulo, Casos: req.Caso},
	}
	if !req.Apply {
		s.execRefinarPreview(w, refReq, st)
		return
	}
	s.execRefinarApply(w, r, refReq, st)
}

func (s *Server) execRefinarPreview(w http.ResponseWriter, req refinar.Request, st processo.Store) {
	pl, err := refinar.Planejar(req, refinar.Deps{Store: st})
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
		return
	}
	resp := map[string]any{
		"nome":     pl.Nome,
		"de":       pl.De,
		"para":     pl.Para,
		"diff":     pl.Diff(),
		"cartao":   pl.Cartao(),
		"mudanca":  pl.Mudanca,
		"avisos":   pl.Avisos,
		"arquivos": pl.Arquivos,
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}

func (s *Server) execRefinarApply(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, req refinar.Request, st processo.Store) {
	confirm := func(pl refinar.Plano, _ func(refinar.Mudanca) (refinar.Plano, error)) (bool, error) {
		return true, nil
	}
	res, err := refinar.Run(r.Context(), req, refinar.Deps{Store: st, Confirm: confirm})
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"status": "ok", "resultado": res})
}

type procRemoverReq struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Apply bool   `json:"apply"`
}

func (s *Server) handleProcessosRemover(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "método não permitido")
		return
	}
	var req procRemoverReq
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "corpo inválido")
		return
	}
	st, err := s.processoStore()
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}
	pl, err := remover.Planejar(r.Context(), remover.Deps{Store: st, Home: s.Home}, req.Name)
	if err != nil {
		code := http.StatusBadRequest
		if errors.Is(err, remover.ErrEmUso) {
			code = http.StatusConflict
		}
		writeError(w, code, err.Error())
		return
	}
	if !req.Apply {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(pl)
		return
	}
	if err := remover.Executar(r.Context(), pl); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"status": "ok", "nome": pl.Nome})
}

type procComporReq struct {
	Name     string   `json:"name"`
	Composto string   `json:"composto"`
	Titulo   string   `json:"titulo"`
	Depende  []string `json:"depende"`
	Apply    bool     `json:"apply"`
}

func (s *Server) handleProcessosCompor(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		writeError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "método não permitido")
		return
	}
	var req procComporReq
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "corpo inválido")
		return
	}
	st, err := s.processoStore()
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}
	compReq := compor.Request{
		Nome:    req.Name,
		Ligacao: compor.Ligacao{Composto: req.Composto, Titulo: req.Titulo, Depende: req.Depende},
	}
	if !req.Apply {
		s.execComporPreview(w, compReq, st)
		return
	}
	s.execComporApply(w, r, compReq, st)
}

func (s *Server) execComporPreview(w http.ResponseWriter, req compor.Request, st processo.Store) {
	pl, err := compor.Planejar(req, compor.Deps{Store: st})
	if err != nil {
		code := http.StatusBadRequest
		if errors.Is(err, processo.ErrCiclo) {
			code = http.StatusConflict
		}
		writeError(w, code, err.Error())
		return
	}
	resp := map[string]any{
		"nome":     pl.Nome,
		"de":       pl.De,
		"para":     pl.Para,
		"diff":     pl.Diff(),
		"cartao":   pl.Cartao(),
		"arquivos": pl.Arquivos,
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}

func (s *Server) execComporApply(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, req compor.Request, st processo.Store) {
	confirm := func(pl compor.Plano, _ func(compor.Ligacao) (compor.Plano, error)) (bool, error) {
		return true, nil
	}
	res, err := compor.Run(r.Context(), req, compor.Deps{Store: st, Confirm: confirm})
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"status": "ok", "resultado": res})
}

package studio

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
)

type revealRequest struct {
	Path string `json:"path"`
}

// resolveSafePath valida e expande caminhos seguros (~ e <projeto>).
func (s *Server) resolveSafePath(raw string) (string, bool, error) {
	if strings.Contains(raw, "..") {
		return "", false, errors.New("caminho com path traversal rejeitado")
	}
	clean := raw
	if strings.HasPrefix(clean, "~/") || strings.HasPrefix(clean, `~\`) || clean == "~" {
		clean = filepath.Join(s.home(), clean[1:])
	} else if strings.HasPrefix(clean, "<projeto>/") || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "<projeto>\\") {
		clean = filepath.Join(s.ProjectDir, clean[len("<projeto>/"):])
	}
	abs, err := filepath.Abs(clean)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	st, err := os.Stat(abs)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, errors.New("caminho inexistente")
	}
	return abs, st.IsDir(), nil
}

func launchExplorer(path string, isDir bool) error {
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		if isDir {
			return exec.Command("explorer.exe", path).Start()
		}
		return exec.Command("explorer.exe", "/select,"+path).Start()
	}
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return exec.Command("open", "-R", path).Start()
	}
	return exec.Command("xdg-open", filepath.Dir(path)).Start()
}

func (s *Server) handleAssetReveal(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req revealRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "JSON inválido", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	abs, isDir, err := s.resolveSafePath(req.Path)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := launchExplorer(abs, isDir); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "falha ao abrir explorador: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true, "path": abs})
}

func TestRevealSafePath(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	f := filepath.Join(tmp, "test.txt")
	if err := os.WriteFile(f, []byte("ok"), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s := &Server{ProjectDir: tmp, Home: tmp}

	abs, isDir, err := s.resolveSafePath(f)
	if err != nil || isDir || abs != f {
		t.Fatalf("resolve falhou: %v, %v, %s", err, isDir, abs)
	}

	// Path traversal deve ser rejeitado
	if _, _, err := s.resolveSafePath("../out.txt"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("path traversal deveria falhar")
	}
}

================ FILE: C:\Users\trcnologia\Desktop\LegoLoop\internal\studio\router_key_test.go ================

package studio

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"legoloop/internal/provider"
)

// As rotas /api/interview, /api/spec e /api/plan montavam o cliente do 9Router sem a chave, e um router
// remoto responde 401. Elas devem seguir a mesma regra do resto do projeto: chave só para a base confiável.
func TestDefaultRouterClientsSendTheTrustedKey(t *testing.T) {
	var auth atomic.Value
	auth.Store("")
	router := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		auth.Store(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
		http.Error(w, "irrelevante para este teste", http.StatusTeapot)
	}))
	defer router.Close()
	t.Setenv("NINEROUTER_URL", router.URL)
	t.Setenv("NINEROUTER_API_KEY", "segredo-studio")

	cases := map[string]string{
		"/api/interview/start": `{"idea":"extrator"}`,
	}
	for path, body := range cases {
		s, _ := newServer(t)
		s.Discover = func(context.Context) provider.Inventory { return provider.Inventory{RouterURL: router.URL} }
		auth.Store("")
		do(t, s.Handler(), "POST", path, body)
		if got := auth.Load().(string); got != "Bearer segredo-studio" {
			t.Errorf("%s enviou Authorization %q; sem a chave o router remoto responde 401", path, got)
		}
	}
}



================ FILE: C:\Users\trcnologia\Desktop\LegoLoop\internal\studio\run_api.go ================

package studio

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"legoloop/internal/dag"
	"legoloop/internal/orchestrix"
	"legoloop/internal/runner"
)

type runDAGRequest struct {
	DAG          json.RawMessage `json:"dag"`
	AllowScripts bool            `json:"allow_scripts"`
}

// handleRunDAG executa o pipeline via SSE, transmitindo progresso por nó em tempo real (R-RUN-1).
// Requer consentimento prévio para execução de scripts (R-RUN-2).
func (s *Server) handleRunDAG(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req runDAGRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]any{"error": "corpo inválido: " + err.Error()})
		return
	}

	d, err := dag.Parse(req.DAG)
	if err != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]any{"error": "dag inválido: " + err.Error()})
		return
	}

	// R-RUN-2: nós script exigem consentimento explícito
	for _, n := range d.Nodes {
		if n.Type == dag.TypeScript && !req.AllowScripts {
			writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]any{
				"error": fmt.Sprintf("execução de nós script (%s) requer consentimento prévio do usuário", n.ID),
			})
			return
		}
	}

	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
	if !ok {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]any{"error": "streaming sse não suportado"})
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	flusher.Flush()

	sendSSE := func(eventType string, payload map[string]any) {
		payload["type"] = eventType
		data, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
		fmt.Fprintf(w, "event: %s\ndata: %s\n\n", eventType, data)
		flusher.Flush()
	}

	sendSSE("dag_start", map[string]any{
		"dag":         d.Name,
		"nodes_total": len(d.Nodes),
		"time":        time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
	})

	exec := &orchestrix.Orchestrix{
		Inventory:    s.inventory(r.Context()),
		AllowScripts: req.AllowScripts,
		LoopStore:    s.Loops,
	}

	opts := runner.Options{
		Workdir:  s.ProjectDir,
		Executor: exec,
		OnNodeStart: func(nodeID string) {
			sendSSE("node_start", map[string]any{
				"id":   nodeID,
				"time": time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
			})
		},
		OnNodeFinish: func(nr runner.NodeReport) {
			sendSSE("node_finish", map[string]any{
				"id":          nr.ID,
				"status":      nr.Status,
				"tokens":      nr.Tokens,
				"model":       nr.Model,
				"duration_ms": nr.Duration.Milliseconds(),
				"notes":       nr.Notes,
				"error":       nr.Error,
			})
		},
	}

	dagStart := time.Now()
	rep, err := runner.Run(r.Context(), d, opts)
	dagDuration := time.Since(dagStart)
	if err != nil {
		sendSSE("dag_error", map[string]any{
			"error":       err.Error(),
			"duration_ms": dagDuration.Milliseconds(),
		})
		return
	}

	// Estimativa média de custo base de tokens LLM (~$0.002/1k input, ~$0.008/1k output)
	costEst := (float64(rep.Tokens.Input)*0.002 + float64(rep.Tokens.Output)*0.008) / 1000.0

	sendSSE("dag_finish", map[string]any{
		"ok":          rep.OK,
		"tokens":      rep.Tokens,
		"duration_ms": dagDuration.Milliseconds(),
		"cost_est":    costEst,
	})
}

package studio

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRunAPIRequiresConsentForScripts(t *testing.T) {
	s, _ := newServer(t)
	h := s.Handler()

	body := `{
		"dag": {
			"name": "script-dag",
			"version": "2.0.0",
			"trigger": {"type": "manual"},
			"nodes": [
				{
					"id": "a",
					"type": "script",
					"command": ["echo", "oi"],

	}

	}

	}

		t.Fatalf("dag_finish deve conter cost_est")
	}
}

package studio

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

// maxBodyBytes limita o corpo de qualquer POST.
const maxBodyBytes = 1 << 20

const csp = "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; " +
	"connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'"

// secure aplica, na ordem: cabeçalhos, Host allowlist, rate limit e regras de POST.
func (s *Server) secure(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	lim := newLimiter(s.RatePerSecond, s.Burst)
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		h := w.Header()
		h.Set("Content-Security-Policy", csp)
		h.Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
		h.Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
		h.Set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
		h.Set("Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy", "same-origin")
		h.Set("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "same-origin")
		h.Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		if !s.hostAllowed(r.Host) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusMisdirectedRequest, "host não permitido")
			return
		}
		if !lim.allow() {
			writeError(w, http.StatusTooManyRequests, "muitas requisições")
			return
		}
		if r.Method == http.MethodPost && !s.postAllowed(w, r) {
			return
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

// hostAllowed bloqueia DNS rebinding: só o endereço de escuta (ou localhost na mesma porta).
func (s *Server) hostAllowed(host string) bool {
	if host == s.Host {
		return true
	}
	_, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(s.Host)
	return err == nil && host == net.JoinHostPort("localhost", port)
}

// postAllowed exige mesma origem e application/json (impede CSRF por formulário simples).
func (s *Server) postAllowed(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
	if o := r.Header.Get("Origin"); o != "" && o != "http://"+r.Host {
		writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "origem cruzada bloqueada")
		return false
	}
	if site := r.Header.Get("Sec-Fetch-Site"); site != "" && site != "same-origin" && site != "none" {
		writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "requisição cross-site bloqueada")
		return false
	}
	mt, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || mt != "application/json" {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType, "Content-Type deve ser application/json")
		return false
	}
	r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, maxBodyBytes)
	return true
}

// decodeComposition decodifica estritamente (campos desconhecidos ⇒ 400).
func decodeComposition(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) (Composition, bool) {
	var c Composition
	dec := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	err := dec.Decode(&c)
	var tooBig *http.MaxBytesError
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &tooBig):
		writeError(w, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "corpo excede 1 MiB")
		return c, false
	case err != nil:
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "composição inválida: "+err.Error())
		return c, false
	case !atEOF(dec):
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "composição inválida: dados extras após o objeto JSON")
		return c, false
	}
	return c, true
}

// limiter é um token bucket simples (servidor local de usuário único).
type limiter struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	rate   float64
	burst  float64
	tokens float64
	last   time.Time
}

func newLimiter(rate float64, burst int) *limiter {
	if rate <= 0 {
		rate = 50
	}
	if burst <= 0 {
		burst = 100
	}
	return &limiter{rate: rate, burst: float64(burst), tokens: float64(burst), last: time.Now()}
}

func (l *limiter) allow() bool {
	l.mu.Lock()
	defer l.mu.Unlock()
	now := time.Now()
	l.tokens = min(l.burst, l.tokens+now.Sub(l.last).Seconds()*l.rate)
	l.last = now
	if l.tokens < 1 {
		return false
	}
	l.tokens--
	return true
}

// atEOF confirma que não há nada além do objeto JSON (inclusive '}' ou ']' soltos).
func atEOF(dec *json.Decoder) bool {
	_, err := dec.Token()
	return errors.Is(err, io.EOF)
}

// ListenAndServe escuta apenas em loopback e encerra graciosamente quando ctx termina.
// Se ready != nil, recebe o endereço efetivo (útil com porta 0).
func (s *Server) ListenAndServe(ctx context.Context, addr string, ready chan<- string) error {
	if err := requireLoopback(addr); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", addr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.Host = ln.Addr().String()
	srv := &http.Server{Handler: s.Handler(), ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
		ReadTimeout: 15 * time.Second, WriteTimeout: 30 * time.Second, MaxHeaderBytes: 64 << 10}
	if ready != nil {
		ready <- s.Host
	}
	errCh := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { errCh <- srv.Serve(ln) }()
	select {
	case err := <-errCh:
		return err
	case <-ctx.Done():
		shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		return srv.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
	}
}

func requireLoopback(addr string) error {
	host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if host == "localhost" {
		return nil
	}
	if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil && ip.IsLoopback() {
		return nil
	}
	return errors.New("studio: só é permitido escutar em loopback (127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost)")
}

func (s *Server) handleBlocks(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
	types := []string{}
	for _, t := range graph.ArtifactTypes() {
		types = append(types, string(t))
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"blocks": s.Index.Blocks(), "types": types, "matrix": s.Index.Matrix(),
	})
}

func (s *Server) inventory(ctx context.Context) provider.Inventory {
	s.invMu.Lock()
	defer s.invMu.Unlock()
	if s.invTime.IsZero() || time.Since(s.invTime) > inventoryTTL {
		s.inv, s.invTime = s.Discover(ctx), time.Now()
	}
	return s.inv
}

// handleInventory expõe só o necessário ao canvas: modelos verdes e nomes de harness.
func (s *Server) handleInventory(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	inv := s.inventory(r.Context())
	clis := []string{}
	for _, c := range inv.CLIs {
		clis = append(clis, c.Name)
	}
	models := inv.Models()
	if models == nil {
		models = []provider.Model{}
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"models": models, "clis": clis, "api_keys": inv.APIKeys, "router_online": inv.RouterURL != "",
	})
}

func (s *Server) handleRoute(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	from := graph.ArtifactType(r.URL.Query().Get("from"))
	to := graph.ArtifactType(r.URL.Query().Get("to"))
	path, cost, err := s.Index.Route(from, to)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, err.Error())
		return
	}
	ids := []string{}
	for _, b := range path {
		ids = append(ids, b.ID)
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"path": ids, "cost": cost})
}

func (s *Server) handleValidate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	c, ok := decodeComposition(w, r)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	res, _ := compose(s.Index, s.inventory(r.Context()), s.resolver(r.Context()), c)
	res.DAG = s.maskDAG(res.DAG)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, res)
}

func (s *Server) handleMaterialize(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	c, ok := decodeComposition(w, r)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	res, d := compose(s.Index, s.inventory(r.Context()), s.resolver(r.Context()), c)
	if !res.OK {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, res)
		return
	}
	data, err := d.Marshal()
	if err == nil {
		err = writeAtomic(s.ProjectDir, PipelineFile, data)
	}
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "falha ao gravar "+PipelineFile)
		return
	}

	// R-RUN-3: Grava a skill orquestradora (< 20 linhas) no cofre canônico
	vault := s.Vault
	if vault == "" {
		home := s.Home
		if home == "" {
			home, _ = os.UserHomeDir()
		}
		if home != "" {
			vault = filepath.Join(home, ".aidd", "canonical")
		}
	}
	if vault != "" && d != nil {
		skillDir := filepath.Join(vault, "skills", "loop-"+d.Name)
		_ = os.MkdirAll(skillDir, 0o755)
		skillPath := filepath.Join(skillDir, "SKILL.md")
		skillContent := fmt.Sprintf(`---
name: loop-%s
description: Executa o loop LegoLoop %s
---
# Loop %s

Execute esta esteira autônoma via LegoLoop:
`+"```bash"+`
legoloop run
`+"```"+`
`, d.Name, d.Name, d.Name)
		_ = os.WriteFile(skillPath, []byte(skillContent), 0o644)
	}

	// R-RUN-3: Registra o loop no acervo se disponível
	if s.Loops != nil && d != nil {
		loopObj := &loop.Loop{
			ID:          d.Name,
			Name:        d.Name,
			Description: d.Description,
			Version:     d.Version,
			Trigger:     d.Trigger,
			Nodes:       d.Nodes,
		}
		_ = s.Loops.Save(loopObj)
	}

	res.Path = PipelineFile
	res.DAG = s.maskDAG(res.DAG) // o arquivo gravado tem os caminhos reais; a resposta, não
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, res)
}

// writeAtomic grava via arquivo temporário + rename, confinado ao diretório do projeto.
func writeAtomic(dir, name string, data []byte) error {
	root, err := os.OpenRoot(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer root.Close()
	tmp := name + ".tmp"
	if err := root.WriteFile(tmp, append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return root.Rename(tmp, name)
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, code int, v any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(code)
	// Cabeçalhos já enviados: um erro aqui só significa cliente desconectado.
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, code int, msg string) {
	writeJSON(w, code, map[string]string{"error": msg})
}

const host = "127.0.0.1:7878"

func newServer(t *testing.T) (*Server, *atomic.Int32) {
	t.Helper()
	idx, err := graph.NewIndex(graph.DefaultCatalog())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var calls atomic.Int32
	s := &Server{
		Index:      idx,
		ProjectDir: t.TempDir(),
		Discover: func(context.Context) provider.Inventory {
			calls.Add(1)
			return provider.Inventory{
				RouterURL: "http://127.0.0.1:20128", RouterModels: []string{"code-pro"},
				Ollama: []string{"qwen2.5-coder:7b"}, CLIs: []provider.CLI{{Name: "claude", Path: `C:\secret\path\claude.exe`}},
				APIKeys: []string{"anthropic"},
			}
		},
		Host: host,
	}
	return s, &calls
}

func do(t *testing.T, h http.Handler, method, path, body string, mut ...func(*http.Request)) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	t.Helper()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(method, "http://"+host+path, strings.NewReader(body))
	req.Host = host
	if body != "" {
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	}
	for _, m := range mut {
		m(req)
	}
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	return rec
}

func decode(t *testing.T, rec *httptest.ResponseRecorder, dst any) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), dst); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("json: %v — corpo: %s", err, rec.Body.String())
	}
}

 {"id":"n2","block":"aidd-spec","routing":{"mode":"auto","combo":"code-pro"}}],
 "edges":[{"from":"n1","to":"n2"}]}`

func TestBlocksEndpoint(t *testing.T) {

		Matrix map[string][]string `json:"matrix"`
	}

func TestValidateDetectsProblems(t *testing.T) {
	s, _ := newServer(t)
	cases := map[string]string{
		"incompatível":              `{"name":"x","nodes":[{"id":"a","block":"interview","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}},{"id":"b","block":"aidd-tdd","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}}],"edges":[{"from":"a","to":"b"}]}`,
		"ciclo":                     `{"name":"x","nodes":[{"id":"a","block":"aidd-tdd","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}},{"id":"b","block":"code-review","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}}],"edges":[{"from":"a","to":"b"},{"from":"b","to":"a"}]}`,
		"bloco inexistente":         `{"name":"x","nodes":[{"id":"a","block":"virus","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}}],"edges":[]}`,
		"artefato colidindo":        `{"name":"x","nodes":[{"id":"a","block":"interview","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}},{"id":"b","block":"aidd-grill","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}}],"edges":[]}`,
		"aresta órfã":               `{"name":"x","nodes":[{"id":"a","block":"interview","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}}],"edges":[{"from":"a","to":"zz"}]}`,
		"aresta duplicada":          `{"name":"x","nodes":[{"id":"a","block":"interview","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}},{"id":"b","block":"aidd-spec","routing":{"mode":"manual","model":"sonnet"}}],"edges":[{"from":"a","to":"b"},{"from":"a","to":"b"}]}`,

func TestPostHardening(t *testing.T) {
	s, _ := newServer(t)
	h := s.Handler()
	cross := do(t, h, "POST", "/api/validate", validComp, func(r *http.Request) { r.Header.Set("Origin", "https://evil.example.com") })
	if cross.Code != 403 {
		t.Fatalf("Origin cruzada aceita: %d", cross.Code)
	}
	same := do(t, h, "POST", "/api/validate", validComp, func(r *http.Request) { r.Header.Set("Origin", "http://"+host) })
	if same.Code != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("mesma origem rejeitada: %d", same.Code)
	}
	ctype := do(t, h, "POST", "/api/validate", validComp, func(r *http.Request) { r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "text/plain") })
	if ctype.Code != 415 {
		t.Fatalf("content-type simples aceito (CSRF): %d", ctype.Code)
	}
	big := `{"name":"` + strings.Repeat("a", maxBodyBytes) + `","nodes":[],"edges":[]}`
	if r := do(t, h, "POST", "/api/validate", big); r.Code != 413 {
		t.Fatalf("payload gigante: %d", r.Code)
	}
	if r := do(t, h, "POST", "/api/validate", `{"name":"x","nodes":[],"edges":[],"__proto__":{}}`); r.Code != 400 {
		t.Fatalf("campo desconhecido aceito: %d", r.Code)
	}
	if r := do(t, h, "GET", "/api/validate", ""); r.Code != 405 {
		t.Fatalf("método errado: %d", r.Code)
	}
}

func TestListenAndServeLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	s, _ := newServer(t)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	ready := make(chan string, 1)
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- s.ListenAndServe(ctx, "127.0.0.1:0", ready) }()
	addr := <-ready
	resp, err := http.Get("http://" + addr + "/api/blocks")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body)
	resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("status %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	cancel()
	if err := <-done; err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("shutdown: %v", err)
	}
}

// SPEC-2026-11-01: Entrega e unificação do Web Component <lego-item-modal>.
func TestLegoItemModalWebComponentDelivery(t *testing.T) {
	s, _ := newServer(t)
	h := s.Handler()

	// 1. Script do Web Component entregue via HTTP
	recJS := do(t, h, "GET", "/components/lego-item-modal.js", "")
	if recJS.Code != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao servir lego-item-modal.js: code %d", recJS.Code)
	}
	jsBody := recJS.Body.String()
	if !strings.Contains(jsBody, "class LegoItemModal extends HTMLElement") {
		t.Fatalf("lego-item-modal.js não contém definição da classe: %s", jsBody)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(jsBody, `customElements.define("lego-item-modal", LegoItemModal)`) {
		t.Fatalf("lego-item-modal.js não registra o custom element")
	}

	// 2. Canvas index.html inclui o web component e não tem o dialog duplicado
	recIndex := do(t, h, "GET", "/", "")
	if recIndex.Code != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao servir /: code %d", recIndex.Code)
	}
	idxBody := recIndex.Body.String()
	if !strings.Contains(idxBody, "components/lego-item-modal.js") {
		t.Fatalf("index.html não inclui script do web component")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(idxBody, `<lego-item-modal id="modal-item">`) {
		t.Fatalf("index.html não instancia <lego-item-modal id=\"modal-item\">")
	}
	if strings.Contains(idxBody, `<dialog id="modal-item" class="dialog modal-item">`) {
		t.Fatalf("index.html ainda contém dialog legado duplicado")
	}

	// 3. Inventário inventario.html inclui o web component e não tem o dialog duplicado
	recInv := do(t, h, "GET", "/inventario", "")
	if recInv.Code != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao servir /inventario: code %d", recInv.Code)
	}
	invBody := recInv.Body.String()
	if !strings.Contains(invBody, "components/lego-item-modal.js") {
		t.Fatalf("inventario.html não inclui script do web component")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(invBody, `<lego-item-modal id="modal-item">`) {
		t.Fatalf("inventario.html não instancia <lego-item-modal id=\"modal-item\">")
	}
	if strings.Contains(invBody, `<dialog id="modal-item" class="dialog modal-item">`) {
		t.Fatalf("inventario.html ainda contém dialog legado duplicado")
	}

	// 4. Verificação de fidelidade de dados: zero frases estáticas mentirosas e presença de auditoria de Gate
	if strings.Contains(jsBody, "Executa tarefas técnicas determinísticas com isolamento estrito de ambiente.") {
		t.Fatalf("lego-item-modal.js ainda contém texto genérico hardcoded")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(jsBody, "_getAuditedArtifact") || !strings.Contains(jsBody, "gate-audit-card") {
		t.Fatalf("lego-item-modal.js não implementa auditoria explícita de artefatos para Gates")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(jsBody, "triad-filters") || !strings.Contains(jsBody, "Substitutas (Swap)") {
		t.Fatalf("lego-item-modal.js não implementa a tríade ontológica de compatibilidade")
	}

	// 5. Paleta preserva campos de contrato
	recPal := do(t, h, "GET", "/palette.js", "")
	if recPal.Code != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao servir palette.js")
	}
	palBody := recPal.Body.String()
	if !strings.Contains(palBody, "consumes: b.consumes") || !strings.Contains(palBody, "artifact: b.artifact") {
		t.Fatalf("palette.js descarta campos de contrato do bloco")
	}

	// 6. API /api/blocks entrega blocos completos com contrato (usando FullCatalog)
	fullIdx, err := graph.NewIndex(graph.FullCatalog())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao criar index FullCatalog: %v", err)
	}
	sFull := &Server{Index: fullIdx, Host: host}
	recBlocks := do(t, sFull.Handler(), "GET", "/api/blocks", "")
	if recBlocks.Code != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("falha em /api/blocks")
	}
	var blocksData struct {
		Blocks []struct {
			ID       string   `json:"id"`
			Kind     string   `json:"kind"`
			Artifact string   `json:"artifact"`
			Gate     string   `json:"gate"`
			Consumes []string `json:"consumes"`
			Produces string   `json:"produces"`
		} `json:"blocks"`
	}
	decode(t, recBlocks, &blocksData)
	var foundGithubTrigger bool
	for _, b := range blocksData.Blocks {
		if b.ID == "github-board-trigger" {
			foundGithubTrigger = true
			if b.Artifact != "WAVE_PLAN.json" {
				t.Fatalf("artefato incorreto para github-board-trigger: %s", b.Artifact)
			}
			if b.Gate != "file_exists('WAVE_PLAN.json')" {
				t.Fatalf("gate incorreto para github-board-trigger: %s", b.Gate)
			}
			if len(b.Consumes) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("gatilho não deve consumir nada, consumiu %v", b.Consumes)
			}
		}
	}
	if !foundGithubTrigger {
		t.Fatalf("github-board-trigger não encontrado em /api/blocks com FullCatalog")
	}

	// 7. Validação das novas peças de Segurança, Git e Deploy em /api/blocks
	expectedEp21 := map[string]string{
		"env-vault":     "security_vault",
		"git-commit":    "vcs_git_commit",
		"deploy-docker": "deploy_docker",
	}
	for id, expectedKind := range expectedEp21 {
		var found bool
		for _, b := range blocksData.Blocks {
			if b.ID == id {
				found = true
				if b.Kind != expectedKind {
					t.Fatalf("bloco %s tem kind incorreto: got %s, want %s", id, b.Kind, expectedKind)
				}
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			t.Fatalf("bloco %s do Épico 21 não encontrado em /api/blocks", id)
		}
	}
}



================ FILE: C:\Users\trcnologia\Desktop\LegoLoop\internal\studio\spec_handlers.go ================

package studio

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"legoloop/internal/interview"
	"legoloop/internal/provider"
	"legoloop/internal/specgen"
)

type specGenerateReq struct {
	IntentPath string `json:"intent_path"`
}

func (s *Server) getSpecGenerator() *specgen.Generator {
	if s.SpecGen != nil {
		return s.SpecGen
	}
	inv := s.inventory(nil)
	client := interview.NewRouterClient(inv.RouterURL, provider.TrustedRouterKey(inv.RouterURL), "code-pro")
	s.SpecGen = specgen.NewGenerator(client, s.Index)
	return s.SpecGen
}

func (s *Server) handleSpecGenerate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "método não permitido", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	var req specGenerateReq
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "JSON inválido: "+err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if req.IntentPath == "" {
		http.Error(w, "o campo 'intent_path' é obrigatório", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	gen := s.getSpecGenerator()
	res, err := gen.Generate(r.Context(), s.ProjectDir, req.IntentPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "falha ao gerar especificação: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(res)
}

package studio

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io/fs"
	"os/exec"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func readStatic(t *testing.T, name string) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := fs.ReadFile(staticFS, "static/"+name)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ler %s: %v", name, err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

// R-UI-3: nenhum diálogo nativo do navegador/SO — feedback é sempre componente próprio.
func TestNoNativeDialogs(t *testing.T) {
	native := regexp.MustCompile(`(^|[^.\w])(window\.)?(alert|confirm|prompt)\s*\(|window\.(alert|confirm|prompt)\b`)
	err := fs.WalkDir(staticFS, "static", func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || d.IsDir() || !(strings.HasSuffix(path, ".js") || strings.HasSuffix(path, ".html")) {
			return err
		}
		b, rerr := fs.ReadFile(staticFS, path)
		if rerr != nil {
			return rerr
		}
		for i, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
			if native.MatchString(line) {
				t.Errorf("%s:%d usa diálogo nativo: %s", path, i+1, strings.TrimSpace(line))
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// R-UI-2: scrollbars de no máximo 4px (vertical e horizontal), thumb a 50% de opacidade.
func TestScrollbarRule(t *testing.T) {
	css := readStatic(t, "style.css")
	track := regexp.MustCompile(`(?s)::-webkit-scrollbar\s*\{[^}]*\}`).FindString(css)
	if track == "" {
		t.Fatal("regra ::-webkit-scrollbar ausente")
	}
	for _, want := range []string{"width: 4px", "height: 4px"} {
		if !strings.Contains(track, want) {
			t.Errorf("::-webkit-scrollbar sem %q", want)
		}
	}
	thumb := regexp.MustCompile(`(?s)::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb\s*\{[^}]*\}`).FindString(css)
	if !strings.Contains(thumb, "var(--scroll-thumb)") {
		t.Error("thumb deve usar o token --scroll-thumb")
	}
	if !regexp.MustCompile(`--scroll-thumb:[^;]*50%`).MatchString(css) {
		t.Error("token --scroll-thumb deve ter 50% de opacidade")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(css, "::-webkit-scrollbar-track") || !strings.Contains(css, "background: transparent") {
		t.Error("trilho deve ser transparente")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(css, "@supports not selector(::-webkit-scrollbar)") {
		t.Error("fallback para navegadores sem ::-webkit-scrollbar ausente")
	}
}

// R-UI-4: Dialog e Toast próprios, carregados antes do app.
func TestUIComponentsServedAndWired(t *testing.T) {
	s, _ := newServer(t)
	if r := do(t, s.Handler(), "GET", "/ui.js", ""); r.Code != 200 {

// A busca é a mesma da página de inventário e (depois) da paleta do canvas: sem acento, sem caixa,
// "-", "_", "." e "/" valem como espaço, e todas as palavras precisam aparecer, em qualquer ordem.
func TestSearchMatching(t *testing.T) {
	node, err := exec.LookPath("node")
	if err != nil {
		t.Skip("node não está no PATH; a regra de busca não pôde ser executada")
	}
	cases := [][3]any{
		{"acesso-plataforma", "ACESSO PLATAFORMA", true},
		{"AIDD Spec", "aidd-spec", true},
		{"Ação Rápida", "acao rapida", true},
		{"code-review-graph", "graph review", true},
		{"skills/aidd.md", "skills aidd md", true},
		{"a_b.c", "a b c", true},
		{"abc", "", true},
		{"abc", "   ", true},
		{"rea", "reasoning", false},
		{"playwright", "mcp", false},
		{"alpha beta", "alpha gamma", false},
	}
	in, _ := json.Marshal(cases)
	script := `const vm=require("vm"),fs=require("fs");const c={};vm.createContext(c);
vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")+";this.m=matchesQuery;",c);
const cases=JSON.parse(process.argv[2]);console.log(JSON.stringify(cases.map(x=>c.m(x[0],x[1]))));`
	out, err := exec.Command(node, "-e", script, "static/search.js", string(in)).CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("node falhou: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	var got []bool
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &got); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("saída inesperada: %s", out)
	}
	for i, c := range cases {
		if got[i] != c[2].(bool) {
			t.Errorf("matchesQuery(%q, %q) = %v, quer %v", c[0], c[1], got[i], c[2])
		}
	}
}

// runNode carrega um script do Studio num contexto isolado e avalia uma expressão (JSON de saída).
func runNode(t *testing.T, expr string, files ...string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	node, err := exec.LookPath("node")
	if err != nil {
		t.Skip("node não está no PATH; a lógica de interface não pôde ser executada")
	}
	script := `const vm=require("vm"),fs=require("fs");const c={console};vm.createContext(c);
for (const f of process.argv.slice(1,-1)) vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"),c,{filename:f});
console.log(JSON.stringify(vm.runInContext(process.argv.at(-1),c)));`
	args := []string{"-e", script}
	for _, f := range files {
		args = append(args, "static/"+f)
	}
	args = append(args, expr)
	out, err := exec.Command(node, args...).CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("node falhou: %v\n%s", err, out)
	}
	return out
}

// TICK-905: a janela virtual nunca renderiza mais que a tela mais a folga, qualquer que seja o total.
func TestVirtualWindowBoundsTheRenderedRows(t *testing.T) {
	out := runNode(t, `(() => {
	  const res = {maxRendered: 0, covers: true, empty: virtualWindow(0, 48, 0, 700), neg: virtualWindow(10, 48, -50, 700)};
	  for (let top = 0; top <= 5000 * 48; top += 37) {
	    const w = virtualWindow(5000, 48, top, 700, 6);
	    res.maxRendered = Math.max(res.maxRendered, w.end - w.start);
	    const first = Math.floor(top / 48), last = Math.min(4999, Math.floor((top + 699) / 48));
	    if (w.start > first || w.end <= last || w.start < 0 || w.end > 5000) res.covers = false;
	  }
	  res.bottom = virtualWindow(5000, 48, 5000 * 48, 700, 6);
	  res.shortList = virtualWindow(3, 48, 0, 700, 6);
	  res.height = virtualWindow(5000, 48, 0, 700).height;
	  return res;
	})()`, "virtual.js")
	var r struct {
		MaxRendered int  `json:"maxRendered"`
		Covers      bool `json:"covers"`
		Empty       struct{ Start, End, Height int }
		Neg         struct{ Start, End int }
		Bottom      struct{ Start, End int }
		ShortList   struct{ Start, End int }
		Height      int `json:"height"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &r); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("saída inesperada: %s", out)
	}
	if r.MaxRendered > 100 {
		t.Errorf("renderizou até %d linhas com 5.000 itens (limite 100)", r.MaxRendered)
	}
	if !r.Covers {
		t.Error("a janela deixou de cobrir as linhas visíveis")
	}
	if r.Empty.End != 0 || r.Empty.Height != 0 || r.Neg.Start != 0 || r.Bottom.End != 5000 ||
		r.ShortList.Start != 0 || r.ShortList.End != 3 || r.Height != 5000*48 {
		t.Errorf("casos de borda: %+v", r)
	}
}

// TestNoInlineStylesInComponents (BUG-CSP-01) assegura que nenhum componente utiliza
// o atributo style="..." inline, prevenindo violações da política Content Security Policy (style-src 'self').
func TestNoInlineStylesInComponents(t *testing.T) {
	inlineStyleRe := regexp.MustCompile(`style\s*=\s*["'][^"']*["']`)
	err := fs.WalkDir(staticFS, "static/components", func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || d.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".js") {
			return err
		}
		b, rerr := fs.ReadFile(staticFS, path)
		if rerr != nil {
			return rerr
		}
		for i, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
			if inlineStyleRe.MatchString(line) {
				t.Errorf("%s:%d viola CSP com style inline: %s", path, i+1, strings.TrimSpace(line))
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

================ FILE: C:\Users\trcnologia\Desktop\LegoLoop\internal\studio\suggest_api.go ================

package studio

import (
	"net/http"

	"legoloop/internal/assets"
	"legoloop/internal/suggest"
)

// suggestKinds são os tipos de peça do inventário que aceitam sugestões.
var suggestKinds = map[string]bool{"skill": true, "script": true, "mcp": true, "subloop": true}

type suggestResponse struct {
	Gates     []suggest.Gate     `json:"gates"`
	Scripts   []assets.Item      `json:"scripts"`
	Hooks     suggestHooks       `json:"hooks"`
	Neighbors []suggest.Neighbor `json:"neighbors"`
}

type suggestHooks struct {
	Pre     []assets.Item `json:"pre"`
	Post    []assets.Item `json:"post"`
	Skipped int           `json:"skipped"`
}

// handleSuggest: GET /api/suggest?block=<id do catálogo> ou ?kind=<tipo>&artifact=<nome>.
// Tudo é calculado só do inventário (sem LLM) e sai sem caminhos absolutos nem comandos brutos.
func (s *Server) handleSuggest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if s.Assets == nil {
		errNoInventory(w)
		return
	}
	q := r.URL.Query()
	ctx, code, msg := s.suggestContext(q.Get("block"), q.Get("kind"), q.Get("artifact"))
	if msg != "" {
		writeError(w, code, msg)
		return
	}
	res := suggest.Suggest(ctx, s.Index, s.snapshot(r.Context()))
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, suggestResponse{
		Gates:     res.Gates,
		Scripts:   s.presentAll(res.Scripts),
		Hooks:     suggestHooks{Pre: s.presentAll(res.HooksPre), Post: s.presentAll(res.HooksPost), Skipped: res.SkippedHooks},
		Neighbors: res.Neighbors,
	})
}

func (s *Server) suggestContext(block, kind, artifact string) (suggest.Context, int, string) {
	switch {
	case block != "" && kind != "":
		return suggest.Context{}, http.StatusBadRequest, "informe block OU kind, não os dois"
	case block != "":
		b, ok := s.Index.Block(block)
		if !ok {
			return suggest.Context{}, http.StatusNotFound, "bloco não existe no catálogo"
		}
		return suggest.Context{Block: &b, Artifact: b.Artifact}, 0, ""
	case kind == "":
		return suggest.Context{}, http.StatusBadRequest, "informe block ou kind"
	case !suggestKinds[kind]:
		return suggest.Context{}, http.StatusBadRequest, "kind desconhecido"
	case artifact == "" || len(artifact) > maxArtifactLen:
		return suggest.Context{}, http.StatusBadRequest, "artifact é obrigatório (até 128 caracteres)"
	}
	return suggest.Context{Kind: kind, Artifact: artifact}, 0, ""
}

func (s *Server) presentAll(items []assets.Item) []assets.Item {
	out := make([]assets.Item, len(items))
	for i, it := range items {
		out[i] = s.present(it)
	}
	return out
}

package studio

import (
	"net/http"

	"legoloop/internal/dag"
)

// Template representa uma esteira pré-fabricada pronta para uso no Canvas (R-UI-5).
type Template struct {
	ID          string      `json:"id"`
	Name        string      `json:"name"`
	Description string      `json:"description"`
	Category    string      `json:"category"`
	Icon        string      `json:"icon"`
	Composition Composition `json:"composition"`
}

package studio

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"testing"
)

func TestTemplatesEndpointReturnsAtLeastThreeValidTemplates(t *testing.T) {
	s, _ := newServer(t)
	h := s.Handler()

	rec := do(t, h, "GET", "/api/templates", "")
	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d; body = %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}

	var res struct {
		Templates []Template `json:"templates"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rec.Body.Bytes(), &res); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao parsear json de templates: %v", err)
	}

	if len(res.Templates) < 3 {
		t.Fatalf("esperava pelo menos 3 templates, obteve %d", len(res.Templates))
	}

	expectedIDs := map[string]bool{
		"greenfield":          false,
		"reverse-engineering": false,
		"security-audit":      false,
		"mega-pipeline":       false,
		"impeccable-design":   false,
		"matt-pocock":         false,
		"addy-osmani":         false,
	}

	for _, tmpl := range res.Templates {
		if _, ok := expectedIDs[tmpl.ID]; ok {
			expectedIDs[tmpl.ID] = true
		}
		if tmpl.Name == "" || tmpl.Description == "" {
			t.Errorf("template %s com campos vazios", tmpl.ID)
		}
		if len(tmpl.Composition.Nodes) == 0 {
			t.Errorf("template %s sem nós", tmpl.ID)
		}
	}

	for id, found := range expectedIDs {
		if !found {
			t.Errorf("template esperado %q não encontrado", id)
		}
	}
}

package studio

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

// TranslationRecord armazena a tradução didática sem tocar no arquivo original.
type TranslationRecord struct {
	SHA256          string `json:"sha256"`
	SourcePath      string `json:"source_path"`
	WhatItIs        string `json:"what_it_is"`
	WhatItDoes      string `json:"what_it_does"`
	WhatItDelivers  string `json:"what_it_delivers"`
	FullContentPTBR string `json:"full_content_ptbr"`
}

func (s *Server) translationCacheDir() (string, error) {
	home := s.Home
	if home == "" {
		var err error
		home, err = os.UserHomeDir()
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
	}
	dir := filepath.Join(home, ".aidd", "cache", "translations")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return dir, nil
}

func (s *Server) validateSafeAssetPath(raw string) (string, error) {
	if strings.Contains(raw, "..") {
		return "", errors.New("caminho com path traversal rejeitado")
	}
	clean := raw
	if strings.HasPrefix(clean, "~/") || strings.HasPrefix(clean, `~\`) || clean == "~" {
		clean = filepath.Join(s.home(), clean[1:])
	} else if strings.HasPrefix(clean, "<projeto>/") || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "<projeto>\\") {
		clean = filepath.Join(s.ProjectDir, clean[len("<projeto>/"):])
	}
	abs, err := filepath.Abs(clean)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	st, err := os.Stat(abs)
	if err != nil || st.IsDir() {
		return "", errors.New("arquivo de ativo inexistente ou inválido")
	}
	return abs, nil
}

func (s *Server) readCachedTranslation(hash string) (*TranslationRecord, error) {
	dir, err := s.translationCacheDir()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, hash+".json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var rec TranslationRecord
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &rec); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &rec, nil
}

func (s *Server) saveCachedTranslation(rec *TranslationRecord) error {
	dir, err := s.translationCacheDir()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(rec, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, rec.SHA256+".json"), data, 0600)
}

func buildDidacticExplanation(path string, content []byte) TranslationRecord {
	h := sha256.Sum256(content)
	hash := hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
	name := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), filepath.Ext(path))
	return TranslationRecord{
		SHA256:          hash,
		SourcePath:      path,
		WhatItIs:        fmt.Sprintf("Peça do ecossistema: %s.", name),
		WhatItDoes:      "Executa rotinas especializadas de automação, engenharia de software e testes.",
		WhatItDelivers:  "Entrega artefatos validados, relatórios estruturados e código de produção em conformidade.",
		FullContentPTBR: string(content),
	}
}

func (s *Server) handleAssetTranslate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req struct {
		Path string `json:"path"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil || req.Path == "" {
		http.Error(w, "JSON inválido ou path ausente", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	cleanPath, err := s.validateSafeAssetPath(req.Path)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	content, err := os.ReadFile(cleanPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "erro ao ler ativo: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	h := sha256.Sum256(content)
	hash := hex.EncodeToString(h[:])
	if rec, err := s.readCachedTranslation(hash); err == nil && rec != nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, rec)
		return
	}
	rec := buildDidacticExplanation(cleanPath, content)
	_ = s.saveCachedTranslation(&rec)
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, rec)
}

package studio

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestTranslateEndpointCacheAndImmutability(t *testing.T) {
	home := t.TempDir()
	skillDir := filepath.Join(home, ".claude", "skills", "test-skill")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(skillDir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	skillFile := filepath.Join(skillDir, "SKILL.md")
	originalContent := "---\nname: english-skill\ndescription: A tool to do magic\n---\n# English Content\nDo this and that."
	if err := os.WriteFile(skillFile, []byte(originalContent), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	srv := &Server{Home: home}
	reqBody, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"path": skillFile})
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/assets/translate", bytes.NewReader(reqBody))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()

	srv.handleAssetTranslate(w, req)

	if w.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("esperava 200 OK, obteve %d: %s", w.Code, w.Body.String())
	}

	var resp struct {
		SHA256          string `json:"sha256"`
		WhatItIs        string `json:"what_it_is"`
		WhatItDoes      string `json:"what_it_does"`
		WhatItDelivers  string `json:"what_it_delivers"`
		FullContentPTBR string `json:"full_content_ptbr"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &resp); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("erro decodificando json: %v", err)
	}
	if resp.SHA256 == "" || resp.WhatItIs == "" {
		t.Errorf("resposta de tradução incompleta: %+v", resp)
	}

	// Verifica se arquivo original foi mantido 100% intacto
	current, err := os.ReadFile(skillFile)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(current) != originalContent {
		t.Errorf("ARQUIVO ORIGINAL FOI MODIFICADO! Esperava %q, obteve %q", originalContent, string(current))
	}
}

func TestTranslateEndpointRejectsPathTraversal(t *testing.T) {
	srv := &Server{Home: t.TempDir()}
	reqBody, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"path": "../../etc/passwd"})
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/assets/translate", bytes.NewReader(reqBody))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()

	srv.handleAssetTranslate(w, req)
	if w.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("esperava 400 Bad Request para traversal, obteve %d", w.Code)
	}
}

// R-UI-6/7: categorias com contadores, catálogo sem duplicata do inventário, busca por palavras.

// Com 5.000 itens a paleta rende dezenas de linhas, não milhares, e a busca é rápida.
func TestPaletteHandlesFiveThousandItemsThroughTheVirtualWindow(t *testing.T) {
	out := runNode(t, `(() => {
	  const skill = Array.from({length: 5000}, (_, i) => ({id: "s" + i, name: "skill-" + String(i).padStart(4, "0")}));
	  const model = buildPaletteModel([], {skill});
	  const flat = flattenPalette(model, "skill", "");
	  const t0 = Date.now();
	  const hits = flattenPalette(model, "all", "skill 4999").length;
	  const window = virtualWindow(flat.length, PALETTE_ROW, 0, 700, 6);
	  return {total: flat.length, rendered: window.end - window.start, hits, ms: Date.now() - t0};
	})()`, "search.js", "virtual.js", "palette.js")
	var r struct{ Total, Rendered, Hits, Ms int }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &r); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("saída inesperada: %s", out)
	}
	if r.Total != 5000 || r.Rendered > 100 || r.Hits != 2 /* cabeçalho + 1 item */ {
		t.Errorf("5.000 itens: %+v", r)
	}
	if r.Ms > 100 {
		t.Errorf("a busca em 5.000 itens levou %d ms (limite 100)", r.Ms)
	}
}

// R-NODE-2/9: lógica pura dos slots (encaixe de gates, hooks por evento, serialização opcional).
func TestSlotsPureLogic(t *testing.T) {
	out := runNode(t, `(() => ({
	  gates: ["file_exists","word_count","line_count","has_binary_criteria","has_acceptance_criteria","has_pattern","desconhecido"]
	    .map((n) => instantiateGate(n, "SPEC.md")),
	  quote: instantiateGate("file_exists", "a'b.md"),
	  hooks: ["PreToolUse","SessionStart","UserPromptSubmit","PreCompact","PostToolUse","Stop","SubagentStop","SessionEnd","Elicitation",""]
	    .map((e) => { const s = hookSlotsFor(e); return (s.pre ? "P" : "-") + (s.post ? "S" : "-"); }),
	  empty: slotsToComposition(emptySlots()) === undefined,
	  full: slotsToComposition({gates: ["g"], scripts: [{ref: "r1", label: "x"}], pre: [{command: "a b", label: "c"}], post: [{ref: "r2"}]}),
	  onlyGate: slotsToComposition({gates: ["g"], scripts: [], pre: [], post: []}),
	  counts: slotCount({gates: ["g"], scripts: [{}], pre: [{}, {}], post: []}),
	}))()`, "slots.js")
	var r struct {
		Gates  []*string
		Quote  *string
		Hooks  []string
		Empty  bool
		Full   map[string]any
		OnlyG  map[string]any `json:"onlyGate"`
		Counts int
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &r); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("saída inesperada: %s", out)
	}
	wantGates := []string{"file_exists('SPEC.md')", "word_count('SPEC.md') > 100", "line_count('SPEC.md') > 10",
		"has_binary_criteria('SPEC.md')", "has_acceptance_criteria('SPEC.md')", "has_pattern('SPEC.md', '')"}
	for i, w := range wantGates {
		if r.Gates[i] == nil || *r.Gates[i] != w {
			t.Errorf("gate %d = %v, quer %q", i, r.Gates[i], w)
		}
	}
	if r.Gates[6] != nil || r.Quote != nil {
		t.Errorf("gate desconhecido ou artefato com aspas deveria dar null: %v %v", r.Gates[6], r.Quote)
	}
	if strings.Join(r.Hooks, ",") != "P-,P-,P-,P-,-S,-S,-S,-S,PS,PS" {
		t.Errorf("slots por evento = %v", r.Hooks)
	}
	if !r.Empty || r.OnlyG["gates"] == nil || r.OnlyG["scripts"] != nil || r.OnlyG["hooks"] != nil || r.Counts != 4 {
		t.Errorf("serialização/contagem: empty=%v onlyGate=%v counts=%d", r.Empty, r.OnlyG, r.Counts)
	}
	hooks, _ := r.Full["hooks"].(map[string]any)
	scripts, _ := r.Full["scripts"].([]any)
	if len(scripts) != 1 || hooks["pre"] == nil || hooks["post"] == nil {
		t.Fatalf("full = %v", r.Full)
	}
	if pre := hooks["pre"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any); pre["command"] != "a b" || pre["label"] != nil || pre["ref"] != nil {
		t.Errorf("pré (comando livre) = %v — só command vai ao servidor", pre)
	}
	if post := hooks["post"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any); post["ref"] != "r2" || post["command"] != nil {
		t.Errorf("pós (ref) = %v", post)
	}
}



================ FILE: C:\Users\trcnologia\Desktop\LegoLoop\internal\suggest\suggest.go ================

// Package suggest calcula, de forma determinística e só a partir do inventário, o que cabe numa
// peça: gates, scripts, hooks (pré e pós) e peças vizinhas. Nenhuma sugestão vem de LLM e nada
// que não exista na máquina é sugerido.
package suggest

import (
	"fmt"
	"path"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"legoloop/internal/assets"
	"legoloop/internal/dag"
	"legoloop/internal/graph"
	"legoloop/internal/reputation"
)

const (
	// MaxItems limita cada lista de scripts e hooks sugeridos.
	MaxItems = 50
	// MaxNeighbors limita as peças de catálogo sugeridas como vizinhas.
	MaxNeighbors = 12
	// MaxMCPNeighbors limita os MCPs do inventário sugeridos como vizinhos.
	MaxMCPNeighbors = 8
	// MaxLoopNeighbors limita os loops do acervo sugeridos como vizinhos.
	MaxLoopNeighbors = 8
)

// Context descreve a peça para a qual se pedem sugestões. Block é o bloco tipado do catálogo
// (nil para peça genérica, cuja saída é "Qualquer"); Artifact é o nome do artefato de saída.
type Context struct {
	Block    *graph.Block
	Kind     string
	Artifact string
}

// Gate é uma expressão de gate sugerida, já instanciada com o artefato da peça.
type Gate struct {
	Expr  string `json:"expr"`
	Label string `json:"label"`
}

// Neighbor é uma peça sugerida para ligar depois desta.
type Neighbor struct {
	Kind      string                  `json:"kind"` // block | mcp
	ID        string                  `json:"id"`
	Name      string                  `json:"name"`
	Installed bool                    `json:"installed"`
	Rating    *reputation.PieceRating `json:"rating,omitempty"`
}

// Result agrupa as sugestões. Todas as listas são vazias (nunca nil) quando não há o que sugerir.
type Result struct {
	Gates        []Gate
	Scripts      []assets.Item
	HooksPre     []assets.Item
	HooksPost    []assets.Item
	SkippedHooks int
	Neighbors    []Neighbor
}

// Suggest monta as sugestões para a peça a partir do catálogo e do inventário.
func Suggest(ctx Context, idx *graph.Index, snap assets.Snapshot) Result {
	pre, post, skipped := hookSuggestions(snap.Of(assets.KindHook))
	return Result{
		Gates:        gateSuggestions(ctx),
		Scripts:      scriptSuggestions(snap.Of(assets.KindScript)),
		HooksPre:     pre,
		HooksPost:    post,
		SkippedHooks: skipped,
		Neighbors:    neighborSuggestions(ctx, idx, snap),
	}
}

// ---------- Gates ----------

func gateSuggestions(ctx Context) []Gate {
	a := ctx.Artifact
	if a == "" || strings.ContainsAny(a, "'\\\n\r") {
		return []Gate{}
	}
	cands := []Gate{{fmt.Sprintf("file_exists('%s')", a), "Arquivo existe"}}
	if strings.EqualFold(filepath.Ext(a), ".md") {
		cands = append(cands,
			Gate{fmt.Sprintf("word_count('%s') > 100", a), "Mais de 100 palavras"},
			Gate{fmt.Sprintf("line_count('%s') > 10", a), "Mais de 10 linhas"})
		if ctx.Block == nil || ctx.Block.Produces == graph.Spec {
			cands = append(cands,
				Gate{fmt.Sprintf("has_binary_criteria('%s')", a), "Tem critérios binários (checklist)"},
				Gate{fmt.Sprintf("has_acceptance_criteria('%s')", a), "Tem seção de critérios de aceitação"})
		}
	}
	own := ""
	if ctx.Block != nil {
		own = ctx.Block.Gate
	}
	out := []Gate{}
	for _, g := range cands {
		if own == "" || !strings.Contains(own, g.Expr) { // o gate próprio do bloco já cobre
			out = append(out, g)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// ---------- Scripts e hooks ----------

// runnable diz se o item vira um comando que o contrato aceita (sem shell, executável válido).
func runnable(it assets.Item) bool {
	if it.Kind == assets.KindHook && assets.ContainsSecret(it.Command) {
		return false // a credencial iria para o pipeline.dag.json
	}
	argv, err := assets.ArgvFor(it)
	return err == nil && dag.ValidateCommand(argv) == nil
}

func scriptSuggestions(items []assets.Item) []assets.Item {
	out := []assets.Item{}
	for _, it := range items {
		if runnable(it) {
			out = append(out, it)
		}
	}
	sort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := out[i], out[j]
		if (a.Scope == "project") != (b.Scope == "project") {
			return a.Scope == "project"
		}
		if an, bn := strings.ToLower(a.Name), strings.ToLower(b.Name); an != bn {
			return an < bn
		}
		return a.Path < b.Path
	})
	return capItems(out)
}

// hookSlots diz em quais slots um evento de hook faz sentido: eventos "Pre*" e de início só
// antes da peça, eventos "Post*" e de fim só depois; os demais valem nos dois.
func hookSlots(event string) (pre, post bool) {
	switch event {
	case "PreToolUse", "SessionStart", "UserPromptSubmit", "PreCompact":
		return true, false
	case "PostToolUse", "Stop", "SubagentStop", "SessionEnd":
		return false, true
	}
	return true, true
}

func hookSuggestions(items []assets.Item) (pre, post []assets.Item, skipped int) {
	pre, post = []assets.Item{}, []assets.Item{}
	for _, it := range items {
		if !runnable(it) {
			skipped++
			continue
		}
		p, q := hookSlots(it.Meta["event"])
		if p {
			pre = append(pre, it)
		}
		if q {
			post = append(post, it)
		}
	}
	return capItems(sortByName(pre)), capItems(sortByName(post)), skipped
}

func sortByName(items []assets.Item) []assets.Item {
	sort.SliceStable(items, func(i, j int) bool {
		a, b := items[i], items[j]
		if an, bn := strings.ToLower(a.Name), strings.ToLower(b.Name); an != bn {
			return an < bn
		}
		return a.Scope < b.Scope
	})
	return items
}

func capItems(items []assets.Item) []assets.Item {
	if len(items) > MaxItems {
		return items[:MaxItems]
	}
	return items
}

// ---------- Vizinhos ----------

func neighborSuggestions(ctx Context, idx *graph.Index, snap assets.Snapshot) []Neighbor {
	installed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, s := range snap.Of(assets.KindSkill) {
		installed[strings.ToLower(s.Name)] = true
	}
	var blocks []graph.Block
	if ctx.Block != nil {
		blocks = idx.Consumers(ctx.Block.Produces)
	} else {
		blocks = idx.Blocks()
	}
	typed := []Neighbor{}
	for _, b := range blocks {
		isInst := installed[strings.ToLower(path.Base(b.Ref))]
		rating := reputation.ScorePiece(b.Ref, b.Label, b.Gate, 1, 1)
		typed = append(typed, Neighbor{
			Kind:      "block",
			ID:        b.ID,
			Name:      b.Label,
			Installed: isInst,
			Rating:    &rating,
		})
	}
	sort.SliceStable(typed, func(i, j int) bool {
		if typed[i].Installed != typed[j].Installed {
			return typed[i].Installed
		}
		// Desempate por Score de Reputação (maior score primeiro)
		scoreI, scoreJ := 0.0, 0.0
		if typed[i].Rating != nil {
			scoreI = typed[i].Rating.TotalScore
		}
		if typed[j].Rating != nil {
			scoreJ = typed[j].Rating.TotalScore
		}
		if scoreI != scoreJ {
			return scoreI > scoreJ
		}
		return strings.ToLower(typed[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(typed[j].Name)
	})
	if len(typed) > MaxNeighbors {
		typed = typed[:MaxNeighbors]
	}
	out := append(typed, mcpNeighbors(snap.Of(assets.KindMCP))...)
	return append(out, loopNeighbors(snap.Of(assets.KindLoop))...)
}

func mcpNeighbors(mcps []assets.Item) []Neighbor {
	sorted := sortByName(append([]assets.Item(nil), mcps...))
	out := []Neighbor{}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, m := range sorted {
		if seen[m.Name] || len(out) >= MaxMCPNeighbors {
			continue
		}
		seen[m.Name] = true
		out = append(out, Neighbor{Kind: "mcp", ID: m.ID, Name: m.Name, Installed: true})
	}
	return out
}

func loopNeighbors(loops []assets.Item) []Neighbor {
	sorted := sortByName(append([]assets.Item(nil), loops...))
	out := []Neighbor{}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, l := range sorted {
		if seen[l.Name] || len(out) >= MaxLoopNeighbors {
			continue
		}
		seen[l.Name] = true
		out = append(out, Neighbor{Kind: "loop", ID: l.ID, Name: l.Name, Installed: true})
	}
	return out
}

package suggest

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"legoloop/internal/assets"
	"legoloop/internal/gate"
	"legoloop/internal/graph"
)

func index(t *testing.T) *graph.Index {
	t.Helper()
	idx, err := graph.NewIndex(graph.DefaultCatalog())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return idx
}

func blockCtx(t *testing.T, idx *graph.Index, id string) Context {
	t.Helper()
	b, ok := idx.Block(id)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("bloco %q não existe", id)
	}
	return Context{Block: &b, Artifact: b.Artifact}
}

func exprs(gs []Gate) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, g := range gs {
		out = append(out, g.Expr)
	}
	return out
}

func has(list []string, want string) bool {
	for _, s := range list {
		if s == want {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func snap(items ...assets.Item) assets.Snapshot { return assets.Snapshot{Items: items} }

func script(name, scope, path string) assets.Item {
	return assets.Item{ID: "s-" + name + scope, Kind: assets.KindScript, Name: name, Scope: scope, Path: path}
}

func hook(event, cmd string) assets.Item {
	return assets.Item{ID: "h-" + event + cmd, Kind: assets.KindHook, Name: event, Scope: "global", Origin: "claude",
		Meta: map[string]string{"event": event}, Command: cmd}
}

func TestGatesForSpecBlockExcludeOwnGateAndAlwaysCompile(t *testing.T) {
	idx := index(t)
	r := Suggest(blockCtx(t, idx, "aidd-spec"), idx, snap())
	got := exprs(r.Gates)
	for _, want := range []string{"file_exists('SPEC.md')", "word_count('SPEC.md') > 100", "line_count('SPEC.md') > 10",
		"has_acceptance_criteria('SPEC.md')"} {
		if !has(got, want) {
			t.Errorf("faltou a sugestão %q em %v", want, got)
		}
	}
	if has(got, "has_binary_criteria('SPEC.md')") {
		t.Error("o gate próprio do bloco não deve ser sugerido de novo")
	}
	for _, g := range r.Gates {
		if _, err := gate.Compile(g.Expr); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("sugestão inválida %q: %v", g.Expr, err)
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(g.Label) == "" {
			t.Errorf("sugestão sem rótulo: %+v", g)
		}
	}
}

func TestGatesDependOnArtifactTypeAndExtension(t *testing.T) {
	idx := index(t)
	// JSON: só existência (o gate próprio do bloco rea já é esse ⇒ nada sobra: estado vazio explícito)
	if r := Suggest(blockCtx(t, idx, "rea"), idx, snap()); len(r.Gates) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("rea (json, gate próprio file_exists) não deveria sugerir nada: %v", exprs(r.Gates))
	}
	// peça genérica .md: oferece existência, tamanho e critérios
	g := exprs(Suggest(Context{Kind: "skill", Artifact: "SAIDA.md"}, idx, snap()).Gates)
	for _, want := range []string{"file_exists('SAIDA.md')", "word_count('SAIDA.md') > 100", "has_binary_criteria('SAIDA.md')"} {
		if !has(g, want) {
			t.Errorf("genérica .md sem %q: %v", want, g)
		}
	}
	// peça genérica .json: só existência
	if g := exprs(Suggest(Context{Kind: "skill", Artifact: "dados.json"}, idx, snap()).Gates); len(g) != 1 || g[0] != "file_exists('dados.json')" {
		t.Errorf("genérica .json = %v", g)
	}
}

func TestHooksSplitByEventAndSkipWhatNeedsAShell(t *testing.T) {
	idx := index(t)
	items := []assets.Item{
		hook("PreToolUse", `rtk hook run`),
		hook("Stop", `notifier done`),
		hook("Elicitation", `rtk elicit`),          // evento desconhecido ⇒ pre e post
		hook("PostToolUse", `echo a | tee b`),      // exige shell ⇒ fora
		hook("SessionStart", `tools/relativo.exe`), // caminho relativo ⇒ fora
		hook("SessionEnd", ``),                     // sem comando ⇒ fora
	}
	r := Suggest(Context{Kind: "skill", Artifact: "A.md"}, idx, snap(items...))
	names := func(l []assets.Item) string {
		var n []string
		for _, h := range l {
			n = append(n, h.Name)
		}
		return strings.Join(n, ",")
	}
	if got := names(r.HooksPre); got != "Elicitation,PreToolUse" {
		t.Errorf("pre = %q", got)
	}
	if got := names(r.HooksPost); got != "Elicitation,Stop" {
		t.Errorf("post = %q", got)
	}
	if r.SkippedHooks != 3 {
		t.Errorf("SkippedHooks = %d, quer 3", r.SkippedHooks)
	}
}

func TestNeighborsForTypedBlockListInstalledFirstThenMCPs(t *testing.T) {
	idx := index(t)
	mcps := []assets.Item{{ID: "m1", Kind: assets.KindMCP, Name: "playwright"}, {ID: "m2", Kind: assets.KindMCP, Name: "rea"}}
	// interview produz Briefing; consumidores: aidd-spec (instalada) — só ele consome Briefing

	}
	if !has(kinds, "mcp") {
		t.Errorf("MCPs do inventário devem aparecer como vizinhos: %v", kinds)
	}
}

// Package vault gerencia credenciais e segredos de forma segura com criptografia
// AES-256-GCM, mascaramento estrito em logs e injeção em nós de execução.
package vault

import (
	"crypto/aes"
	"crypto/cipher"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

// Vault gerencia pares chave-valor criptografados em memória e persistidos em disco.
type Vault struct {
	mu          sync.RWMutex
	storagePath string
	key         []byte
	secrets     map[string]string
}

// New cria uma nova instância do cofre. Se storagePath for vazio, opera apenas em memória.
func New(storagePath string, masterKey string) (*Vault, error) {
	if masterKey == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("vault: chave mestra não pode ser vazia")
	}

	derivedKey := deriveKey(masterKey)

	return &Vault{
		storagePath: storagePath,
		key:         derivedKey,
		secrets:     make(map[string]string),
	}, nil
}

// deriveKey gera uma chave criptográfica simétrica de 256 bits (32 bytes) a partir da semente.
func deriveKey(masterKey string) []byte {
	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(masterKey))
	return hash[:]
}

// Set adiciona ou atualiza um segredo no cofre.
func (v *Vault) Set(key, value string) error {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()

	if key == "" {
		return errors.New("vault: chave não pode ser vazia")
	}
	v.secrets[key] = value
	return nil
}

// Get recupera o valor de um segredo pelo identificador.
func (v *Vault) Get(key string) (string, bool) {
	v.mu.RLock()
	defer v.mu.RUnlock()

	val, ok := v.secrets[key]
	return val, ok
}

// ListKeys lista todos os identificadores de segredos armazenados (sem revelar os valores).
func (v *Vault) ListKeys() []string {
	v.mu.RLock()
	defer v.mu.RUnlock()

	keys := make([]string, 0, len(v.secrets))
	for k := range v.secrets {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	return keys
}

// Save serializa e criptografa os segredos em disco usando AES-256-GCM.
func (v *Vault) Save() error {
	v.mu.RLock()
	defer v.mu.RUnlock()

	if v.storagePath == "" {
		return nil
	}

	payload, err := json.Marshal(v.secrets)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("vault: falha na serialização json: %w", err)
	}

	encrypted, err := encrypt(payload, v.key)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("vault: falha na criptografia: %w", err)
	}

	dir := filepath.Dir(v.storagePath)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("vault: falha ao criar diretório do storage: %w", err)
	}

	if err := os.WriteFile(v.storagePath, encrypted, 0600); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("vault: falha ao gravar arquivo seguro: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

// Load lê e decriptografa os segredos salvos em disco.
func (v *Vault) Load() error {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()

	if v.storagePath == "" {
		return errors.New("vault: storagePath não configurado")
	}

	raw, err := os.ReadFile(v.storagePath)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("vault: falha ao ler arquivo: %w", err)
	}

	decrypted, err := decrypt(raw, v.key)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("vault: falha na decriptografia (chave inválida ou arquivo corrompido): %w", err)
	}

	var data map[string]string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(decrypted, &data); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("vault: dados decriptografados inválidos: %w", err)
	}

	v.secrets = data
	return nil
}

// MaskSecrets substitui valores sensíveis presentes no texto fornecido por ***MASKED***.
func (v *Vault) MaskSecrets(raw string) string {
	v.mu.RLock()
	defer v.mu.RUnlock()

	result := raw
	for _, val := range v.secrets {
		if len(val) >= 4 { // Apenas valores com comprimento mínimo razoável para evitar falsos positivos
			result = strings.ReplaceAll(result, val, "***MASKED***")
		}
	}
	return result
}

var envVarRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`\$\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\}`)

// ResolveEnv substitui variáveis no formato ${VAR_NAME} pelos valores do cofre ou variáveis do SO.
func (v *Vault) ResolveEnv(tmpl string) string {
	v.mu.RLock()
	defer v.mu.RUnlock()

	return envVarRegex.ReplaceAllStringFunc(tmpl, func(match string) string {
		varName := match[2 : len(match)-1]
		if val, ok := v.secrets[varName]; ok {
			return val
		}
		if sysVal := os.Getenv(varName); sysVal != "" {
			return sysVal
		}
		return match
	})
}

// encrypt cifra os bytes usando AES-256-GCM com nonce aleatório prependado.
func encrypt(plaintext []byte, key []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	block, err := aes.NewCipher(key)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	gcm, err := cipher.NewGCM(block)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	nonce := make([]byte, gcm.NonceSize())
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(rand.Reader, nonce); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	ciphertext := gcm.Seal(nonce, nonce, plaintext, nil)
	return ciphertext, nil
}

// decrypt autentica e decifra os bytes usando AES-256-GCM.
func decrypt(ciphertext []byte, key []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	block, err := aes.NewCipher(key)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	gcm, err := cipher.NewGCM(block)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	nonceSize := gcm.NonceSize()
	if len(ciphertext) < nonceSize {
		return nil, errors.New("ciphertext muito curto")
	}

	nonce, actualCiphertext := ciphertext[:nonceSize], ciphertext[nonceSize:]
	plaintext, err := gcm.Open(nil, nonce, actualCiphertext, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return plaintext, nil
}

package vault_test

import (
	"os"

	"strings"

func TestVault_EncryptDecryptAndPersistence(t *testing.T) {
	tmpDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "vault_test_*")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao criar tmpDir: %v", err)
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(tmpDir)

	vaultFile := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "vault.enc")
	masterKey := "super-secret-master-key-12345"

	// 1. Cria vault novo e insere segredos
	v, err := vault.New(vaultFile, masterKey)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao instanciar vault: %v", err)
	}

	if err := v.Set("OPENAI_API_KEY", "sk-proj-1234567890abcdef"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("erro ao setar segredo: %v", err)
	}
	if err := v.Set("DB_PASSWORD", "mypassword!@#"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("erro ao setar segredo: %v", err)
	}

	// Persiste em disco
	if err := v.Save(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao salvar vault: %v", err)
	}

	// 2. Garante que o arquivo salvo em disco NÃO contém os segredos em texto puro
	rawDisk, err := os.ReadFile(vaultFile)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao ler vaultFile do disco: %v", err)
	}
	if strings.Contains(string(rawDisk), "sk-proj-1234567890abcdef") {
		t.Fatalf("vazamento de segredo! texto puro encontrado no arquivo gravado")
	}
	if strings.Contains(string(rawDisk), "mypassword!@#") {
		t.Fatalf("vazamento de senha! texto puro encontrado no arquivo gravado")
	}

	// 3. Carrega o vault em uma nova instância usando a mesma chave mestra
	v2, err := vault.New(vaultFile, masterKey)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao instanciar vault 2: %v", err)
	}
	if err := v2.Load(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("falha ao carregar vault existente: %v", err)
	}

	val, ok := v2.Get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
	if !ok || val != "sk-proj-1234567890abcdef" {
		t.Fatalf("valor recuperado incorreto: got %q, ok=%v", val, ok)
	}

	valPass, ok := v2.Get("DB_PASSWORD")
	if !ok || valPass != "mypassword!@#" {
		t.Fatalf("valor de senha recuperado incorreto: got %q, ok=%v", valPass, ok)
	}
}

package videomotion

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

var (
	// ErrInvalidBookConfig indica parâmetros incompletos para a geração do livro.
	ErrInvalidBookConfig = errors.New("videomotion: configuração do livro didático inválida")
)

// DidacticBookConfig parametriza a criação do manual em formato de livro.
type DidacticBookConfig struct {
	OutputDir    string
	PipelineName string
	Version      string
}

// LegoPressBookManifest representa a estrutura canônica de livro.json no LegoPress.
type LegoPressBookManifest struct {
	VersaoManifesto  string   `json:"versao_manifesto"`
	Titulo           string   `json:"titulo"`
	NomeBase         string   `json:"nome_base"`
	PastaPartes      string   `json:"pasta_partes"`
	Template         string   `json:"template"`
	Partes           []string `json:"partes"`
	Revisoes         []string `json:"revisoes"`
	HashFonte        string   `json:"hash_fonte"`
	UltimaCompilacao string   `json:"ultima_compilacao"`
}

// GenerateDidacticBook cria o livro didático canônico na pasta docs/books/<nome>.
func GenerateDidacticBook(cfg DidacticBookConfig) (string, error) {
	if cfg.OutputDir == "" || cfg.PipelineName == "" {
		return "", ErrInvalidBookConfig
	}
	bookDir := filepath.Join(cfg.OutputDir, cfg.PipelineName)
	partesDir := filepath.Join(bookDir, "partes")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(partesDir, 0755); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	manifest, chapters := buildBookChapters(cfg)
	if err := writeChapters(partesDir, chapters); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return writeManifest(bookDir, manifest)
}

func writeChapters(partesDir string, chapters map[string]string) error {
	for file, content := range chapters {
		path := filepath.Join(partesDir, file)
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0644); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func writeManifest(bookDir string, manifest LegoPressBookManifest) (string, error) {
	manifestPath := filepath.Join(bookDir, "livro.json")
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(manifest, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return manifestPath, os.WriteFile(manifestPath, data, 0644)
}

func buildBookChapters(cfg DidacticBookConfig) (LegoPressBookManifest, map[string]string) {
	manifest := LegoPressBookManifest{
		VersaoManifesto: "1.0",
		Titulo:          "Pipeline Canônico de Motion Video",
		NomeBase:        "2026-11-07_PIPELINE-MOTION-VIDEO",
		PastaPartes:     "partes",

		Partes: []string{
			"00-frontmatter.md",
			"01-macro-fundacao.md",
			"02-meso-arquitetura-4-pilares.md",
			"03-micro-passo-a-passo.md",
			"04-pratica-receitas-multi-aspecto.md",
			"05-rotina-diff-updater.md",
		},
		Revisoes:         []string{},
		HashFonte:        cfg.PipelineName + "-v" + cfg.Version,
		UltimaCompilacao: "2026-11-07",
	}
	chapters := map[string]string{
		"00-frontmatter.md":                    cap0Content,

	}
	return manifest, chapters
}
